title: Shells: One High and Two High
learnerWin: Recognize the safety shell as an initial clue and wait for the post-snap rotation before declaring coverage.
lab: Use Coach Vision or replay to compare a one-high and two-high pre-snap picture.
Call one run and one quick pass from the same formation.
Watch a safety rotate after the snap. Say what changed—not what you hoped the defense was.
sources: EA Sports, Madden NFL 27 Gameplay Deep Dive.
EA Sports, Madden NFL 27 Controls Hub.
